# DRIVING EVEN FASTER DATACOM

See why the rapid growth in AI/ML is driving a demand for faster datacom enabled by innovative
Coherent solutions.

[ Read the Blog ][53]

# 1.6T-DR8 TRANSCEIVER

Silicon photonics-based 1.6T-DR8 transceiver module using a Marvell® Ara 3 nm optical digital signal
processor (DSP), featuring 200 Gbps electrical and optical interfaces.

[ Learn More ][54]

# OPTICAL CIRCUIT SWITCH

The OCS optimizes data center networks by minimizing electrical switches and
optical-electrical-optical (OEO) conversions, resulting in significant cost savings, reduced power
consumption, and improved latency for GPU connections.

[ Learn More ][55]

# PRECISION MANUFACTURING

Weld metals and heat thermoplastic composites with efficiency, high throughput, and reduced costs.

[ Learn More ][56]

# SEMI CAP EQUIPMENT

Build equipment that maximizes throughput and yield using cutting-edge optics, lasers, and composite
materials.

[ Learn More ][57]

# DISPLAY MANUFACTURING

Deliver laser solutions that drive innovations in display manufacturing and performance, especially
for mobile devices.

[ Learn More ][58]

# NVIDIA and Coherent

Announce Strategic Partnership to Develop Optics Technology to Scale Next-Generation Data Center
Architecture

[ Learn More ][59]

# Building the Infrastructure for the AI Era

Announced the modernization and expansion of our Sherman facility, supported by a proposed $50
million CHIPS Act award.

[ Learn More ][60]

## WE HARNESS PHOTONS TO DRIVE INNOVATION

The photon is the fundamental building block of our universe. See how we use it to generate,
modulate, amplify, direct, and detect for the datacenter, communications, and industrial markets.

## Markets

### Datacenter and Communications

### Datacenter

Enable ultra-high-speed data transmission and optimized power efficiency for hyperscale and
enterprise datacenters with our advanced optical transceivers, active optical cables, and
high-performance laser and component solutions.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][61]

### Communications

Transform global communications networks with our comprehensive portfolio of coherent transceivers
and modules, lasers, amplifiers, and photonic devices. Our innovations support faster, more
efficient data transport across metro, long-haul, subsea, and space-based networks.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][62]

### Industrial

### Precision Manufacturing

Perform fast, high-precision cutting, welding, marking, and ablation of metals and plastics with
laser sources and systems.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][63]

### Semiconductor & Display Capital equipment

Innovative, high-precision equipment and laser solutions for next-gen chips and mobile displays.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][64]

### Automotive & Energy Solutions

Meet EV production challenges with cutting-edge technology that improves performance and
reliability, and also lowers costs.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][65]

### Instrumentation

See how we’re helping professionals and institutions — from research facilities and OEMs to
hospitals and dentists — achieve better outcomes.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][66]

## EVENTS

[

### Lasers & Photonics Taiwan

#### August 19 - 22, 2026
#### 1F, Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center (TaiNEX), Hall 2

Join Coherent at Laser & Photonics Taiwan 2026, the premier annual event for the laser and photonics
industry, showcasing the latest advancements in advanced manufacturing, smart automation,
semiconductors, electric vehicles, and biomedicine. Visit us at Booth P502 to discover cutting-edge
laser solutions and photonics technologies designed to power the next generation of manufacturing
and industrial applications. Meet with our experts and explore how Coherent is enabling innovation
across industries.

Learn More
][67]

Coherent Corp., a global leader in photonics, has been awarded on TIME’s list of America’s Best
Companies 2026.

Read More
][69] [

### Coherent Announces a CHIPS Letter of Intent for $50 Million to Expand World-Leading
### Manufacturing Facility for AI Infrastructure

#### June 16, 2026

Proposed award will support new manufacturing jobs and expanded American production of critical
optical networking technologies that power next-generation AI datacenters.

Read More

## Highlight

### The Industry’s Most Vertically Integrated Datacom Transceivers

From Silicon photonics, VCSEL arrays, lenses, filters and couplers, and isolators, Coherent is a
vertically integrated supplier alleviating supply chain uncertainty to better support our customers.

[ Read the Blog ][53]

# 1.6T-DR8 TRANSCEIVER

Silicon photonics-based 1.6T-DR8 transceiver module using a Marvell® Ara 3 nm optical digital signal
processor (DSP), featuring 200 Gbps electrical and optical interfaces.

[ Learn More ][54]

# OPTICAL CIRCUIT SWITCH

The OCS optimizes data center networks by minimizing electrical switches and
optical-electrical-optical (OEO) conversions, resulting in significant cost savings, reduced power
consumption, and improved latency for GPU connections.

[ Learn More ][55]

# PRECISION MANUFACTURING

Weld metals and heat thermoplastic composites with efficiency, high throughput, and reduced costs.

[ Learn More ][56]

# SEMI CAP EQUIPMENT

Build equipment that maximizes throughput and yield using cutting-edge optics, lasers, and composite
materials.

[ Learn More ][57]

# DISPLAY MANUFACTURING

Deliver laser solutions that drive innovations in display manufacturing and performance, especially
for mobile devices.

[ Learn More ][58]

# NVIDIA and Coherent

Announce Strategic Partnership to Develop Optics Technology to Scale Next-Generation Data Center
Architecture

[ Learn More ][59]

# Building the Infrastructure for the AI Era

Announced the modernization and expansion of our Sherman facility, supported by a proposed $50
million CHIPS Act award.

[ Learn More ][60]

## WE HARNESS PHOTONS TO DRIVE INNOVATION

The photon is the fundamental building block of our universe. See how we use it to generate,
modulate, amplify, direct, and detect for the datacenter, communications, and industrial markets.

## Markets

### Datacenter and Communications

### Datacenter

Enable ultra-high-speed data transmission and optimized power efficiency for hyperscale and
enterprise datacenters with our advanced optical transceivers, active optical cables, and
high-performance laser and component solutions.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][61]

### Communications

Transform global communications networks with our comprehensive portfolio of coherent transceivers
and modules, lasers, amplifiers, and photonic devices. Our innovations support faster, more
efficient data transport across metro, long-haul, subsea, and space-based networks.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][62]

### Industrial

### Precision Manufacturing

Perform fast, high-precision cutting, welding, marking, and ablation of metals and plastics with
laser sources and systems.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][63]

### Semiconductor & Display Capital equipment

[ Discover Our Solutions ][64]

### Automotive & Energy Solutions

Meet EV production challenges with cutting-edge technology that improves performance and
reliability, and also lowers costs.

[ Discover Our Solutions ][65]

### Instrumentation

hospitals and dentists — achieve better outcomes.

## MORE THAN 20,000 ARTICLES.

**+** LASER COMPONENTS is your partner for detectors, emitters, fiber optics, and optics. The
applications for laser optics and optoelectronics are as diverse as the technologies themselves:
Sensor technology, range finding, biotechnology with environmental and life science, aerospace &
defense, science and research or medical technology are just a few examples. Our product engineers
keep track of everything in this complex world. They work with you to find the best technologies and
products to match your application. Many components in our portfolio are made at our own production
sites. Most of them are the result of customer-cooperation, because at LASER COMPONENTS, we go
“beyond borders” to ensure your success.

* Together with you, we develop the ideal component for your application.
* We manufacture ourselves.
* Components from premium partners offer additional choices.
* In more than 40 years, we have built up a strong worldwide network.
* As an owner-managed family business, we stand by our values in the long term and remain
  financially independent.  
* Our 283 employees generate a turnover of over 65 million euros worldwide.
* Our redundant machinery protects you from production downtimes.
* All production facilities are certified according to DIN ISO 9001; in Germany also according to EN

## Redefining Laser Solutions

At Novanta, we empower manufacturing leaders and innovators to accelerate operational excellence and
expand what’s possible. For over 50 years, we’ve delivered precision, speed, and scalability through
an integrated technology stack of laser sources, best-in-class beam steering, scanning, and
end-to-end control.

The breadth and depth of our comprehensive laser solutions portfolio enable us to deliver complete,
configurable solutions that can be deployed individually or seamlessly integrated as
high‑performance subsystems. By combining industry‑leading technologies with our proprietary
precision mirrors and advanced process monitoring capabilities, we ensure superior quality,
reliability, and control at every stage of the manufacturing process.


The result is faster time to value, higher yield, and laser systems engineered to meet the most
demanding precision manufacturing applications.

[View Product Portfolio][115]
[View Applications][116]

## Complete Laser Solutions Portfolio

Discover solutions and view products.

## Laser Sources

Compact, reliable CO2, solid-state continuous wave, and ultrafast laser sources engineered for
faster, easier integration.

[View Laser Sources][117]
[Novanta XY galvanometer set]

## Beam Steering

High precision beam steering components and solutions engineered to deliver consistent reliability,
speed, and accuracy.

[View Beam Steering][118]

## Software & Controllers

## You See Innovation, We See Your Roadmap

We are component and system-level experts who understand the critical inter-dependencies between
fluidics, optics, microfluidics, and integrated sub-assemblies. We specialize in the complete
optofluidic pathway to help you avoid project risks and are uniquely positioned to solve even the
most demanding challenges in a wide array of applications.
* [Fluidics][117]
* [Semrock Optical Filters][118]
* [OEM Optical Systems][119]
* [Fluidic Systems][120]

###### Column Hardware

Explore our extensive line of HPLC and UHPLC column hardware optimized to enable selectivity,
efficiency, and high-quality separation performance in your flow paths.

[Shop Now **][121]

###### Degassers

Explore our broad portfolio of vacuum degassing assemblies to control bubbles in a wide range of
system-fluids and flow-rates.

[Shop Now **][122]

###### Fluidic Connections

Explore our comprehensive line of tubing, connectors, fittings, and flow control devices that meet
the increasingly demanding requirements of today’s high performance analytical fluidic systems.

[Shop Now **][123]

###### Manifolds

Integrate multiple fluidic components into a unified fluidic module.

[Shop Now **][124]

###### Pumps

Explore our long-life precision dispense pumps designed for use in a range of clinical and
laboratory instruments.

[Shop Now **][125]

###### Sensors

Accurately monitor and control your pressure to achieve accurate instrument output and maximized
system capabilities with our sensors.

[Shop Now **][126]

###### RI Detectors

Achieve high resolution and low dispersion detection with our RI detectors for HPLC applications.

[Shop Now **][127]

###### Valves

Explore manual valves for lower frequency use, rotary shear valves that meet the high duty cycle
requirements of UHPLC, and more

[Shop Now **][128]

###### Individual Filters

Select your bandpass, edge filters, dichroics, and more by key fluorophores.

[Shop Now **][129]

###### Optical Filter Sets

Explore single-band and multi-band sets for popular applications and wavelengths.

[Shop Now **][130]

###### Shop by Fluorophore

Looking for a filter set to go with your fluorophore? Use the chart on this page to find which
Semrock optical filter sets are compatible with popular fluorophores.

[Shop Now **][131]

###### SearchLight

Select the elements of your fluorescence system and quickly calculate a relative signal brightness,
autofluorescence level, and signal to noise ratio.

[Start Plotting Now **][132]

###### Discontinued Semrock Optical Filter Products

Our products are regularly revised to improve performance. Find replacement products here.

[Shop Now **][133]

###### Cubes / Holders

Find a cube designed to mount filters for your application.

[Shop Now **][134]

###### Breadboarding

Accelerate your path to discovery with high-performance custom optical components including imaging
optics, diode laser engines and laser autofocus tracking and push the boundaries of what is possible
from industrial to life science, diagnostic, and medical technology.

[Learn More **][135]

###### Custom

At IDEX Health & Science, we provide the customized optical performance to move beyond prototyping
into robust, market-ready instrumentation.

[Learn More **][136]

###### Manufacturing Scale

Whether you are a startup launching your first instrument or a global OEM shipping thousands, our
Life Science Optics (LSO) team provides the infrastructure of a world leader with the accessibility
of a direct engineering partner.

[Learn More **][137]

###### Fluidic Subsystems

Challenged with minimizing expensive reagent volumes while maintaining a cost effective, reliable
platform? Partner with our fluidic design and engineering experts to manufacture subsystem solutions
to mitigate risk to performance and minimize cost.

[Learn More **][138]

###### Custom Fluidic Solutions

Enhancing reliability, preventing leakage, minimizing carryover, and enhancing usability. These are
a few of the many advantages in partnering with us for custom fluidic solutions.

[Learn More **][139]

We believe partnership will change the way the world innovates, leading to new technologies that
improve our health, protect our planet, and enrich our lives.

## The Key to the Future is Collaboration

Watch the below videos to discover how IDEX Health & Science partners with industry experts to
change the way the world innovates. We help design and manufacture new technologies that improve our
health, protect our planet, and enrich our lives.

## About Us

We are the global leader in life science fluidics, microfluidics, and optics, offering a three-fold
advantage to customers by bringing optofluidic paths to life with strategic partnerships, solutions,
and expertise. As one of the few companies in the world with component, sub-system, and application
level experts, IDEX Health & Science helps instrument developers solve the most demanding fluidic
and optical challenges in a wide array of applications.

[Learn More][140]

optofluidic pathway to help you avoid project risks and are uniquely positioned to solve even the
most demanding challenges in a wide array of applications.
* [Fluidics][117]
* [Semrock Optical Filters][118]
* [OEM Optical Systems][119]
* [Fluidic Systems][120]

###### Column Hardware

Explore our extensive line of HPLC and UHPLC column hardware optimized to enable selectivity,
efficiency, and high-quality separation performance in your flow paths.

[Shop Now **][121]

###### Degassers

Explore our broad portfolio of vacuum degassing assemblies to control bubbles in a wide range of
system-fluids and flow-rates.

[Shop Now **][122]

###### Fluidic Connections

Explore our comprehensive line of tubing, connectors, fittings, and flow control devices that meet
the increasingly demanding requirements of today’s high performance analytical fluidic systems.

[Shop Now **][123]

###### Manifolds

Integrate multiple fluidic components into a unified fluidic module.

[Shop Now **][124]

###### Pumps

Explore our long-life precision dispense pumps designed for use in a range of clinical and
laboratory instruments.

[Shop Now **][125]

###### Sensors

Accurately monitor and control your pressure to achieve accurate instrument output and maximized
system capabilities with our sensors.

[Shop Now **][126]

###### RI Detectors

Achieve high resolution and low dispersion detection with our RI detectors for HPLC applications.

[Shop Now **][127]

###### Valves

Explore manual valves for lower frequency use, rotary shear valves that meet the high duty cycle
requirements of UHPLC, and more

[Shop Now **][128]

###### Individual Filters

Select your bandpass, edge filters, dichroics, and more by key fluorophores.

[Shop Now **][129]

###### Optical Filter Sets

Explore single-band and multi-band sets for popular applications and wavelengths.

[Shop Now **][130]

###### Shop by Fluorophore

Looking for a filter set to go with your fluorophore? Use the chart on this page to find which
Semrock optical filter sets are compatible with popular fluorophores.

[Shop Now **][131]

###### SearchLight

Select the elements of your fluorescence system and quickly calculate a relative signal brightness,
autofluorescence level, and signal to noise ratio.

[Start Plotting Now **][132]

###### Discontinued Semrock Optical Filter Products

Our products are regularly revised to improve performance. Find replacement products here.

[Shop Now **][133]

###### Cubes / Holders

Find a cube designed to mount filters for your application.

[Shop Now **][134]

###### Breadboarding

Accelerate your path to discovery with high-performance custom optical components including imaging
optics, diode laser engines and laser autofocus tracking and push the boundaries of what is possible
from industrial to life science, diagnostic, and medical technology.

[Learn More **][135]

###### Custom

At IDEX Health & Science, we provide the customized optical performance to move beyond prototyping
into robust, market-ready instrumentation.

[Learn More **][136]

###### Manufacturing Scale

Whether you are a startup launching your first instrument or a global OEM shipping thousands, our
Life Science Optics (LSO) team provides the infrastructure of a world leader with the accessibility
of a direct engineering partner.

[Learn More **][137]

###### Fluidic Subsystems

Challenged with minimizing expensive reagent volumes while maintaining a cost effective, reliable
platform? Partner with our fluidic design and engineering experts to manufacture subsystem solutions
to mitigate risk to performance and minimize cost.

[Learn More **][138]

###### Custom Fluidic Solutions

Enhancing reliability, preventing leakage, minimizing carryover, and enhancing usability. These are
a few of the many advantages in partnering with us for custom fluidic solutions.

[Learn More **][139]

We believe partnership will change the way the world innovates, leading to new technologies that
improve our health, protect our planet, and enrich our lives.

## The Key to the Future is Collaboration

Watch the below videos to discover how IDEX Health & Science partners with industry experts to
change the way the world innovates. We help design and manufacture new technologies that improve our
health, protect our planet, and enrich our lives.

## About Us

We are the global leader in life science fluidics, microfluidics, and optics, offering a three-fold
advantage to customers by bringing optofluidic paths to life with strategic partnerships, solutions,
and expertise. As one of the few companies in the world with component, sub-system, and application
level experts, IDEX Health & Science helps instrument developers solve the most demanding fluidic
and optical challenges in a wide array of applications.

# Powering the next generation of scientific and photonic innovation

AdvR’s non-linear optical technologies enable access to wavelengths beyond standard commercial
availability, supporting advanced applications across industrial, technological, and scientific
research sectors.

[View our solutions][101]

## Powering the science of light

350 nm

6 µm

## Explore our solutions

### Frequency Conversion

AdvR offers fiber-coupled and free-space frequency conversion solutions in waveguide and bulk
MgO:PPLN, PPLN, and PPKTP, delivering customizable, cost-effective, high-efficiency UV-to-MIR up-
and down-conversion.
* [ Free Space Solutions ][102]
* [ Fiber Coupled Solutions ][103]
* [ Frequency Conversion Custom Solutions ][104]

Speak to an expert [More info][105]

### Electro-Optic Modulation

Our electro-optic modulation solutions span near-UV to telecom wavelengths, supporting applications
in atomic, molecular, and optical physics, laser stabilization, sensing, communications, and quantum
technologies.
* [ Visible Phase Modulators ][106]
* [ Visible Amplitude Modulators ][107]
* [ Telecom Modulators ][108]
* [ Custom Modulator Solutions ][109]

Speak to an expert [More Info][110]

### Laser Systems

Our laser systems include frequency-stabilized and widely tunable platforms, delivering
narrow-linewidth CW output alongside high-performance picosecond and femtosecond pulse generation.
* [ CW Laser System ][111]
* [ Pulsed Laser System ][112]

Speak to an expert [More Info][113]

### Electronics & Accessories

AdvR provides integrated packaging, mounting, thermal control, and electronics solutions to ensure
reliable performance and seamless system integration for fiber-coupled, free-space, waveguide, and
bulk-crystal devices.
* [ Temperature Controllers ][114]
* [ Oven and TEC Mounts ][115]
* [ Device Mounts & Packaging ][116]
* [ Custom Electronics ][117]

Speak to an expert [More Info][118]

# Powering the next generation of scientific and photonic innovation

AdvR’s non-linear optical technologies enable access to wavelengths beyond standard commercial
availability, supporting advanced applications across industrial, technological, and scientific
research sectors.

[View our solutions][101]

## Powering the science of light

350 nm

6 µm

## Explore our solutions

### Frequency Conversion

AdvR offers fiber-coupled and free-space frequency conversion solutions in waveguide and bulk
MgO:PPLN, PPLN, and PPKTP, delivering customizable, cost-effective, high-efficiency UV-to-MIR up-
and down-conversion.
* [ Free Space Solutions ][102]
* [ Fiber Coupled Solutions ][103]
* [ Frequency Conversion Custom Solutions ][104]

Speak to an expert [More info][105]

### Electro-Optic Modulation

Our electro-optic modulation solutions span near-UV to telecom wavelengths, supporting applications
in atomic, molecular, and optical physics, laser stabilization, sensing, communications, and quantum
technologies.
* [ Visible Phase Modulators ][106]
* [ Visible Amplitude Modulators ][107]
* [ Telecom Modulators ][108]
* [ Custom Modulator Solutions ][109]

Speak to an expert [More Info][110]

### Laser Systems

Our laser systems include frequency-stabilized and widely tunable platforms, delivering
narrow-linewidth CW output alongside high-performance picosecond and femtosecond pulse generation.
* [ CW Laser System ][111]
* [ Pulsed Laser System ][112]

Speak to an expert [More Info][113]

### Electronics & Accessories

AdvR provides integrated packaging, mounting, thermal control, and electronics solutions to ensure
reliable performance and seamless system integration for fiber-coupled, free-space, waveguide, and
bulk-crystal devices.
* [ Temperature Controllers ][114]
* [ Oven and TEC Mounts ][115]
* [ Device Mounts & Packaging ][116]
* [ Custom Electronics ][117]

Speak to an expert [More Info][118]

## About us

AdvR, part of the Hawthorn Photonics Group, offer a wide selection of fiber coupled frequency
conversion units in waveguide and bulk MgO:PPLN, PPLN, and PPKTP. With this broad product portfolio,
AdvR can provide an ideal solution for an application’s unique efficiency and power requirements.

AdvR’s capabilities in waveguide and bulk MgO:PPLN, PPLN, and PPKTP allow for a wide range of
up-conversion and down-conversion interactions from the UV to MIR wavelengths. Free space solutions
offer a customizable high-efficiency solution at a reduced price

### Our team of specialist engineers and technical sales experts provides detailed guidance to help
### you identify and implement the most effective non-linear optical solution for your specific
### system requirements.

# Attendance on Demand

Attendance on Demand is a cloud-based solution that fully automates employee time and labor tracking
and scheduling.

[Solutions][20] [What Is Attendance on Demand?][21]

## Powerful, Reliable Time and Labor Solutions

We are committed to helping businesses that depend on their workforce meet their key goals. Our
solutions enable companies to win the war for talent with collaboration and communication tools that
increase employee engagement.

## Product Features

From core essentials to innovative services, Attendance on Demand’s product offerings are designed
to help you meet your business’s workforce challenges.

### Time and Labor

Maximize your workforce while lowering labor costs.

### Employee Scheduling

Make the scheduling process collaborative and efficient.

### Compliance

Supporting compliance with complex, evolving labor laws.

[View Features][22]

## Time Clocks

Power your workforce management solution with devices designed to meet the demands of your work
environment.
* Touchscreens
* Finger, Hand, and Facial Readers
* Badge Readers
* PIN Readers

## About Us

Attendance on Demand employees are driven to innovate, deliver, and support the highest-quality
workforce management technology solutions. Consistently ahead of the market, our automated,
human-centered products intelligently solve workforce planning challenges and integrate with the
best payroll and HCM platforms.

[Learn More][24]

## Partner With Us

### Integration Services

Delight your customers with a seamless experience that shares data in real time and saves them time
and money while ensuring accuracy.

### Referral Partners

Provide your sales team with an enterprise-level workforce management solution that expands your
payroll, HCM, or ERP offering.

### Reseller Partners

Offer businesses a modern, intuitive, engaging user interface experience that makes work life better
for their employees.

[Explore Partnerships][25]

## Laserapplikationen, die sich anpassen. Nicht umgekehrt.

Ihre Fertigung passt sich nicht an die Laserkomponenten an, sondern die Komponenten an Ihre
Fertigung. Möglich wird das durch unsere eigene Hard- und Software, tiefes Applikations-Know-how und
den Fokus auf anspruchsvolle Metallbearbeitung.

[UNSERE LÖSUNGEN FÜR SIE][28]

## Laserapplikationen mit System

Wir von AUXXOS verstehen uns als Partner für individuelle Laserapplikationen, nicht nur als reiner
Equipment-Lieferant für Laserquellen und Bearbeitungsoptiken. Unsere Systeme entstehen im Dialog mit
Ihnen: prozessoptimiert, modular und mit maximaler Integrationstiefe.
[

## Bearbeitungsoptiken

Unsere Bearbeitungsoptiken stammen aus eigener Entwicklung und Fertigung und lassen sich präzise auf
Ihre Anforderungen abstimmen. Sie sind für Schneid-, Schweiß- und Sonderapplikationen geeignet und
lassen sich prozesssicher in Ihre Fertigung integrieren.

][29][

## Laserquellen

Wir entwickeln und fertigen eigene Faserlaser für die industrielle Lasermaterialbearbeitung. Ob
Schweißlaser, Schneidlaser oder MOPA-System – unsere Laserquellen werden individuell parametriert

## High-End Custom Optical Components Manufacturer

We are a professional optical elements and lenses manufacturer with over 20 years of industry
experience. We specialize in optical coatings, precision optical design, and the production of
various optical mirrors and lenses.
* Established in 2005
* Employees 90+

* R&D team is led by a PhD in opto-mechanics and consists of 10 experienced members
* 3 operations globally

## Application

The optical solutions we provide to customers around the world have achieved remarkable results in
many fields

### High-end camera optical systems

We provide precision spherical and aspherical lenses to internationally renowned camera brands for
use in professional photography systems.

### Medical Microscope Solutions

Provide high-precision optical components for medical diagnostic equipment to ensure the clarity and
accuracy of medical images.

### Industrial laser system applications

Provide special optical lenses and coating services for laser processing equipment to improve
processing efficiency and precision.

### Optical design of scientific research instruments

Customized optical system design and production for scientific research institutions to support
cutting-edge scientific research.

## Elevate Your Optics With Bote

Bote is your single-source partner for **precision optical components** and **custom lens
assemblies** that drive mission-critical imaging, sensing, and laser systems. From prototype to
volume production, our Singapore facility combines world-class [**optical design, diamond-turning
and CNC grinding & polishing, thin-film coating, and clean-room lens assembly**][159] under one [ISO
9001:2015-certified quality management system][160].
* 📄 [**Precision Optics Catalog**][161] – complete specifications for lenses, prisms, windows,
  filters, and coatings. Download PDF

[Interferometer by Zygo]

## End-to-End Custom Lens Solutions

Our opto-mechanical engineers leverage Zemax® and SolidWorks® to co-optimize glass selection,
tolerance budgets, and housing design. In-house MTF, interferometry, and environmental testing
ensure every assembly meets or exceeds **DO-160, MIL-STD-810, and ISO 10110** requirements. Whether
you need athermalized SWIR zooms, compact board-level lenses, or ruggedized machine-vision
objectives, Bote delivers turn-key modules that integrate fast and perform flawlessly.

Previous slide
Next slide

**Metrology That Matches Your Ambition**
We certify every optic on state-of-the-art [**4D interferometers, Trioptics® centration testers, and
PerkinElmer spectrophotometers**][162]. Data packages include full surface maps, wavefront error,
and spectral transmission curves, giving you traceable confidence from R&D through mass production.

**Quality & Industry Engagement**
Bote operates under an[ **ISO 9001:2015** ][163]framework, reinforcing our commitment to
repeatability and continuous improvement. As a proud **SPIE Corporate Member**, we stay at the
forefront of photonics innovation, contributing technical papers and collaborating with global
research partners.

Partner with Bote to accelerate your next optical breakthrough—**from visible to far-infrared, from
single elements to complex lens systems, we engineer light so you can engineer the future.**
* 📄[ **Custom Optical Lens Catalog**][164] – design guides and performance data for fixed-focus,
  zoom, and IR lens assemblies. Download PDF

## Elevate Your Optics With Bote

Bote is your single-source partner for **precision optical components** and **custom lens
assemblies** that drive mission-critical imaging, sensing, and laser systems. From prototype to
volume production, our Singapore facility combines world-class [**optical design, diamond-turning
and CNC grinding & polishing, thin-film coating, and clean-room lens assembly**][159] under one [ISO
9001:2015-certified quality management system][160].

## End-to-End Custom Lens Solutions

Our opto-mechanical engineers leverage Zemax® and SolidWorks® to co-optimize glass selection,
tolerance budgets, and housing design. In-house MTF, interferometry, and environmental testing
ensure every assembly meets or exceeds **DO-160, MIL-STD-810, and ISO 10110** requirements. Whether
you need athermalized SWIR zooms, compact board-level lenses, or ruggedized machine-vision
objectives, Bote delivers turn-key modules that integrate fast and perform flawlessly.

**Metrology That Matches Your Ambition**
We certify every optic on state-of-the-art [**4D interferometers, Trioptics® centration testers, and
PerkinElmer spectrophotometers**][162]. Data packages include full surface maps, wavefront error,
and spectral transmission curves, giving you traceable confidence from R&D through mass production.

research partners.

## About Us

Chongqing Smart Science & Technology Development Co. Ltd, founded in August 2010, is a high-tech
enterprise specializing in the R&D, manufacturing and sales of acousto-optic devices and driving
power supplies, optical active and passive devices, lasers and their related devices. Its products
are widely used in laser manufacturing, optical fiber sensing, quantum research and other fields.

As a professional supplier of optical products, we have won the trust of many customers in the
United Kingdom, the United States, France, Germany, Canada, Korea, Japan, and so on. We also work
with universities, R&D LABS, enterprises, and OEM customers around the world to provide standard or
custom components for the most demanding applications. Our mission is to manufacture high-quality
and state-of-the-art products for our customers, driving innovation and change in many application
areas and markets.

enterprise specializing in the R&D, manufacturing and sales of acousto-optic devices and driving

## You See Innovation, We See Your Roadmap

We are component and system-level experts who understand the critical inter-dependencies between
fluidics, optics, microfluidics, and integrated sub-assemblies. We specialize in the complete
optofluidic pathway to help you avoid project risks and are uniquely positioned to solve even the
most demanding challenges in a wide array of applications.
* [Fluidics][117]
* [Semrock Optical Filters][118]
* [OEM Optical Systems][119]
* [Fluidic Systems][120]

###### Column Hardware

Explore our extensive line of HPLC and UHPLC column hardware optimized to enable selectivity,
efficiency, and high-quality separation performance in your flow paths.

[Shop Now **][121]

###### Degassers

Explore our broad portfolio of vacuum degassing assemblies to control bubbles in a wide range of
system-fluids and flow-rates.

[Shop Now **][122]

###### Fluidic Connections

Explore our comprehensive line of tubing, connectors, fittings, and flow control devices that meet
the increasingly demanding requirements of today’s high performance analytical fluidic systems.

[Shop Now **][123]

###### Manifolds

Integrate multiple fluidic components into a unified fluidic module.

[Shop Now **][124]

###### Pumps

Explore our long-life precision dispense pumps designed for use in a range of clinical and
laboratory instruments.

[Shop Now **][125]

###### Sensors

Accurately monitor and control your pressure to achieve accurate instrument output and maximized
system capabilities with our sensors.

[Shop Now **][126]

###### RI Detectors

Achieve high resolution and low dispersion detection with our RI detectors for HPLC applications.

[Shop Now **][127]

###### Valves

Explore manual valves for lower frequency use, rotary shear valves that meet the high duty cycle
requirements of UHPLC, and more

[Shop Now **][128]

###### Individual Filters

Select your bandpass, edge filters, dichroics, and more by key fluorophores.

[Shop Now **][129]

###### Optical Filter Sets

Explore single-band and multi-band sets for popular applications and wavelengths.

[Shop Now **][130]

###### Shop by Fluorophore

Looking for a filter set to go with your fluorophore? Use the chart on this page to find which
Semrock optical filter sets are compatible with popular fluorophores.

[Shop Now **][131]

###### SearchLight

Select the elements of your fluorescence system and quickly calculate a relative signal brightness,
autofluorescence level, and signal to noise ratio.

[Start Plotting Now **][132]

###### Discontinued Semrock Optical Filter Products

Our products are regularly revised to improve performance. Find replacement products here.

[Shop Now **][133]

###### Cubes / Holders

Find a cube designed to mount filters for your application.

[Shop Now **][134]

###### Breadboarding

Accelerate your path to discovery with high-performance custom optical components including imaging
optics, diode laser engines and laser autofocus tracking and push the boundaries of what is possible
from industrial to life science, diagnostic, and medical technology.

[Learn More **][135]

###### Custom

At IDEX Health & Science, we provide the customized optical performance to move beyond prototyping
into robust, market-ready instrumentation.

[Learn More **][136]

###### Manufacturing Scale

Whether you are a startup launching your first instrument or a global OEM shipping thousands, our
Life Science Optics (LSO) team provides the infrastructure of a world leader with the accessibility
of a direct engineering partner.

[Learn More **][137]

###### Fluidic Subsystems

Challenged with minimizing expensive reagent volumes while maintaining a cost effective, reliable
platform? Partner with our fluidic design and engineering experts to manufacture subsystem solutions
to mitigate risk to performance and minimize cost.

[Learn More **][138]

###### Custom Fluidic Solutions

Enhancing reliability, preventing leakage, minimizing carryover, and enhancing usability. These are
a few of the many advantages in partnering with us for custom fluidic solutions.

[Learn More **][139]

We believe partnership will change the way the world innovates, leading to new technologies that
improve our health, protect our planet, and enrich our lives.

## The Key to the Future is Collaboration

Watch the below videos to discover how IDEX Health & Science partners with industry experts to
change the way the world innovates. We help design and manufacture new technologies that improve our
health, protect our planet, and enrich our lives.

## About Us

We are the global leader in life science fluidics, microfluidics, and optics, offering a three-fold
advantage to customers by bringing optofluidic paths to life with strategic partnerships, solutions,
and expertise. As one of the few companies in the world with component, sub-system, and application
level experts, IDEX Health & Science helps instrument developers solve the most demanding fluidic
and optical challenges in a wide array of applications.

## Find the Product For You
* Lasers
  
  As a leading fiber laser manufacturer in China, JPT offers a full range of lasers, including MOPA
  laser, CW laser, DPSS laser, and diode lasers. JPT delivers high-performance and flexible
  industrial laser solutions.
  
  [Learn More][122]
* Optical Devices
  
  JPT delivers high-density optical components and connectivity solutions with ultra-low insertion
  loss, ideal for data centers, base stations, and FTTx networks, from a trusted laser equipment
  supplier.
  
  
  
  [Learn More][123]
* Core Modules
  
  JPT develops self-designed laser welding modules. Ensuring stable and consistent processing, these
  are widely integrated into vision positioning and detection, driving intelligent upgrades and
  yield improvement.
  
  [Learn More][124]
* Intelligent Equipment
  
  JPT intelligent equipment includes Chip Resistor, Module Tester, Green Energy, and Advance Laser
  solutions. Using proprietary lasers and precision control, our systems optimize key processes in
  batteries, automotive electronics, and semiconductors for higher efficiency and superior yields.
  
  [Learn More][125]

As a leading fiber laser manufacturer, JPT's strategic presence spans leading customers in consumer
electronics, data centers, next-generation telecom infrastructure, precision manufacturing for
electric vehicles, new energy lithium battery manufacturing, and advanced information technologies
such as AR/VR.

## Find the Product For You
* Lasers
  
  As a leading fiber laser manufacturer in China, JPT offers a full range of lasers, including MOPA
  laser, CW laser, DPSS laser, and diode lasers. JPT delivers high-performance and flexible
  industrial laser solutions.
  
  [Learn More][122]
* Optical Devices
  
  JPT delivers high-density optical components and connectivity solutions with ultra-low insertion
  loss, ideal for data centers, base stations, and FTTx networks, from a trusted laser equipment
  supplier.
  
  
  
  [Learn More][123]
* Core Modules
  
  JPT develops self-designed laser welding modules. Ensuring stable and consistent processing, these
  are widely integrated into vision positioning and detection, driving intelligent upgrades and
  yield improvement.
  
  [Learn More][124]
* Intelligent Equipment
  
  JPT intelligent equipment includes Chip Resistor, Module Tester, Green Energy, and Advance Laser
  solutions. Using proprietary lasers and precision control, our systems optimize key processes in
  batteries, automotive electronics, and semiconductors for higher efficiency and superior yields.
  
  [Learn More][125]

# Photonics Solutions for Diverse Applications

LDI Innovation is a Research & Development and Engineering Company operating with
novel *Photonics* and *Information and Communication* technologies in industrial, environmental and
security domains.

The Company R&D, Engineering and Integration services portfolio includes developing photonics
sensors and systems providing *real-time *and *on-line* sensing solutions for industries,
environmental protection, medicine, and bio-chemical security and safety.

[[Research and Development]][25]

## Research and Development

We provide various technological R&D services in photonics, including feasibility assessment,
concept verification, data analysis, and application development based on our core knowledge and
know-how. We also develop embedded and PC-side software for operation control and real-time data
acquisition and processing using advanced techniques.

[Read More][26]

[[Engineering and Manufacturing]][27]

## Engineering and Manufacturing

We are experienced in delivering various types of Engineering services, from development and
verification of technical solutions through prototyping to system development based on prototype,
and complete system design. The Company manufactures the excimer lasers and a range of laser- and
spectroscopy based instrumentations.

[Read More][28]

[[Integration and Diversification]][29]

## Integration and Diversification

We innovate by integration of emerging photonic components in our developments and products for
real-time and on-line sensing applications. We also diversify the applications and customize the
products according to the client needs. By request the Company is able to provide the sensor fusion
and the data fusion according to specified CONOPS.

[Read More][30]

**PHOTONICS SPECTRA presented the concept of water-quality monitoring sensors offered by LDI
Innovation. “The integration of optical and nonoptical techniques into shared workflows is enabling
more comprehensive and effective water monitoring”**. **[ Read more …][31]**

# Photonics Solutions for Diverse Applications

LDI Innovation is a Research & Development and Engineering Company operating with
novel *Photonics* and *Information and Communication* technologies in industrial, environmental and
security domains.

The Company R&D, Engineering and Integration services portfolio includes developing photonics
sensors and systems providing *real-time *and *on-line* sensing solutions for industries,
environmental protection, medicine, and bio-chemical security and safety.

[[Research and Development]][25]

## Research and Development

We provide various technological R&D services in photonics, including feasibility assessment,
concept verification, data analysis, and application development based on our core knowledge and
know-how. We also develop embedded and PC-side software for operation control and real-time data
acquisition and processing using advanced techniques.

[Read More][26]

[[Engineering and Manufacturing]][27]

## Engineering and Manufacturing

We are experienced in delivering various types of Engineering services, from development and
verification of technical solutions through prototyping to system development based on prototype,
and complete system design. The Company manufactures the excimer lasers and a range of laser- and
spectroscopy based instrumentations.

[Read More][28]

[[Integration and Diversification]][29]

## Integration and Diversification

We innovate by integration of emerging photonic components in our developments and products for
real-time and on-line sensing applications. We also diversify the applications and customize the
products according to the client needs. By request the Company is able to provide the sensor fusion
and the data fusion according to specified CONOPS.

[Read More][30]

**PHOTONICS SPECTRA presented the concept of water-quality monitoring sensors offered by LDI
Innovation. “The integration of optical and nonoptical techniques into shared workflows is enabling
more comprehensive and effective water monitoring”**. **[ Read more …][31]**

## This year marks Moog’s 75th anniversary, reflecting decades of resilience and ingenuity.

Founded in 1951 by Bill Moog with a bold vision to empower people and solve tough problems through
trust and innovation, our company grew from a small airplane hangar in East Aurora into a global
leader in aerospace, defense, industrial automation, and medical technology. Through change and
challenge, Moog has remained committed to innovation and culture. Today, we continue to shape the
way our world moves while building a sustainable business for generations to come.

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

## Used by Over 2000 Companies

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

[ Search now ][41]
[ Plug in our data ][42]

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

# Сustom Optical Manufacturing Company

We are Manufacturers of Advanced Optical Components and Assemblies.

Shanghai Optics is an unparalleled custom optical engineering solution provider offering custom
optical manufacturing, design and engineering services. We’re one of the top custom lens
manufacturers that specializes in custom lens assembly and delivers the best cost-effective custom
optical solutions in the photonics industry. By combining high-quality custom components with the
latest state of the art advanced metrology, our experts deliver breakthrough custom optical design
solutions and engineering consulting for the toughest optical problems.

[ Contact Us ][211]

## Features

[Precision optical lens surface inspection]
[Custom optical lens assembly design cross-section]
[Precision optical metrology and testing equipment]

## Why Shanghai Optics?

Delivering the highest quality of service and value to customers from start to finish.
We’re dedicated to being the supplier you choose for your custom optic fabrication. From volume
production to prototype, we will meet any require specifications at the most cost effective
solution.

Our other benefits include:
* **Quick, no-obligation quotes.**
* **Worry-free returns.**
* **Unprecedented customer service**
* **Quick, no-obligation quotes.**
* **Worry-free returns.**
* **Unprecedented customer service**

[Precision optical lenses arranged in cleanroom manufacturing batch tray]
[Custom wide-angle and objective optical lens assemblies]
[Close-up of adjustable aperture diaphragm blades inside optical lens barrel]

# #1 Optical Manufacturer Advantages

Our ability to provide high precision optics at the best price/performance ratios makes us the
perfect partner.

S.O. has over 60 years of optical design, optimization and manufacturing experience with a presence
in North America

All design and manufacturing are done in-house, so we have full control of each stage starting with
the raw materials to the finished products.

# Global Custom Optics Manufacturing Facility and Capabilities

Shanghai Optics design, manufacture and assemble custom lens systems/optical components from our
global manufacturing facility. Learn about our capabilities, which includes diamond turning aspheric
lens manufacturing, high laser damage threshold optical coating and state of the art metrology.

# Custom Optical Engineering Solutions

[Lens System Design]

#### Lens System Design

No matter what kind of custom optical design you're looking for, our custom lens manufacturer will
make your vision a reality. We provide custom objectives including deep ultraviolet applications to
infrared photography, metrology, monitoring, microscopy and other custom optical lenses. Our
projection lens designers and concept evaluation teams are the best at what they do.

[Tools and Softwares]

#### Tools and Softwares

Part of our custom optical engineering solutions includes the utilization of the latest and most
innovative technologies. Our team of experienced engineers use Zemax®, CODE V® and ASAP® for
simulation and modeling techniques. Our network of mechanical engineers use SolidWorks® and
Pro/ENGINEER® for custom optical design and complex COSMOS® to conduct thermal analysis and other
simulations like diffraction light and stray light analysis.

[Illumination System Design]

#### Illumination System Design

We're proud to be a custom lens manufacturer that specializes in designing automated lighting
systems, street lights and other indoors and outdoor lighting design systems. We also provide custom
components, individual design and customized services to meet and exceed your expectations.
